nvitk.gui.tools.descriptions.tool_description_text(tool_id: str, *, fallback_label: str = '') → str¶

Human-readable description for tool_id from TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS, falling back to fallback_label (or a generic prompt) when no description or tool id is available.

Per-label tools (GuiToolSpec.multilabel) get MULTILABEL_NOTE appended.
